name: FrydeMC
description:
FrydeMC Network is a Minecraft server supporting versions 1.7 to the latest.

You can play Survival, OneBlock, and take part in UHC events every Sunday. The server includes features like teams, homes, player teleports, and custom world generation to make gameplay more exciting.

Find a team, grind, socialise, start wars, and become the richest player.

Website: https://fryde.org
